mlb_news.title: Dodgers' Diaz to have elbow surgery, miss months
mlb_news.summary: Los Angeles Dodgers closer Edwin Diaz is scheduled to undergo surgery Wednesday to remove loose bodies in his right elbow, the team announced Monday, and the expectation is that he could miss around three months, a source told ESPN's Alden Gonzalez.

mlb_news.title: Braves' Acuna hit twice by Nationals; X-rays clean
mlb_news.summary: The Braves said X-rays were negative and that Ronald Acuna Jr. was day-to-day.

mlb_news.title: Counsell: MLB rule in place for Ohtani 'bizarre'
mlb_news.summary: Chicago Cubs manager Craig Counsell thinks that a Major League Baseball rule that allows the Los Angeles Dodgers to carry 14 pitchers because of Shohei Ohtani is "bizarre," adding that the defending National League MVP is getting "special consideration."

mlb_news.title: Amid threats, Yanks' Schlittler excited to face Sox
mlb_news.summary: Yankees pitcher Cam Schlittler said he and his family have received threats ahead of his start vs. the Red Sox, but he's "excited" to be making his Fenway Park debut.

mlb_news.title: Jays bus from Phoenix to SoCal after plane issue
mlb_news.summary: A mechanical issue with their charter plane forced the Blue Jays to bus from Phoenix to Orange County on Sunday night.
